# Eva Gebbinck

> Official website of Eva Gebbinck, a Dutch actor and theatre-maker who graduated from the acting programme at HKU University of the Arts Utrecht in 2025.

## Pages

- [Home](https://eva.gebbinck.nl/): biography, portraits, selected work, professional profiles, and contact details.
- [Sihame](https://eva.gebbinck.nl/sihame.html): Eva's role as Charlene in the KRO-NCRV drama series.

## Selected facts

- Full name: Eva Nova Gebbinck.
- Profession: actor and theatre-maker.
- Acting training: HKU University of the Arts Utrecht, 2019–2025.
- Languages: Dutch, English, German, and French.
- Television: Sihame (2022), as Charlene.
- Contact: eva@gebbinck.nl.
